title: Facet-Defining Inequalities for the Angle-Based DC Optimal Transmission Switching Formulation
summary: The switching of transmission lines can significantly improve the economic and operational efficiency of power systems. The Direct-Current Optimal Transmission Switching (DC-OTS) problem provides a formal framework for minimizing power generation costs by reconfiguring the transmission network topology under a linearized power flow model. DC-OTS is typically formulated as a mixed-integer linear program that incorporates disjunctive constraints to capture the required relationships between certain variables via big-M parameters.
